Eva: Quick sync 30 pulled the last 6 wks of postmortems and built a compact recurrence table. We have 5 repeat causes. Need tiny owners+ETAs so we can close follow-ups. Link: https://redwood.internal/trackers/recurrence-6w.csv

Marcus: drop the top 5 pls

Eva: Top causes: 1) downstream rate-limit bursts -> queue pileups, 2) autoscaler threshold drift, 3) overlapping canary windows, 4) cache eviction cascades, 5) edge auth token expiries.

Leah: For scope, suggest 2-step fixes: (A) fast mitigation (<=2w) and (B) automation (<=8w). Owners for (A) first.

Connor: I'll take #1 fast mitigation: per-host shed + alert. ETA 2026-06-04.

Marcus: I'll take #2 (autoscaler lint + nightly diff) ETA 2026-05-30.

Leah: I'll take #3 (canary preflight + runbook) ETA 2026-06-02.

Eva: For #4 I'll prototype TTL jitter and soft-evict bump. ETA 2026-05-28. For #5 Leah can own fallback refresh retry with metrics?

Leah: Yep I can do #5 small fix (retry + metric) ETA 2026-05-29.

PagerBot: Follow-up created: INC-FW-2026-1408 assigned -> Connor, Marcus, Leah, Eva. Due 2026-06-10.

Connor: Q: do we mark regressions? Some incidents are regressions from last release.

Eva: Add a "regression" boolean column in the tracker and tag postmortems that need updates. Also add "est monthly cost" to help prioritization.

Marcus: Blocker for autoscaler tests: need access to config-compute env. Opened INF-4950 and cc'd infra.

Leah: Suggest a recurring 20m monthly sync to keep this light. Wednesdays 10:30 PT?

Eva: Scheduling now. First recurring 2026-05-22 10:30 PT. Invite sent.

Marcus: Small ask: can we add a column for "SLO hits" so support can see customer impact?

Eva: Done. Tracker updated and posted. Link: https://redwood.internal/trackers/recurrence-6w.csv

Connor: I'll update the follow-up ticket with PR links as I land mitigation.

Leah: ack

Marcus: ack

Eva: Thanks all30 closing thread once PRs linked in tracker. If blocked, reply with ticket ID.
